name: HSWM causal-composition research program
canonical_role: Order falsifiable tests of outcome-bound local causal learning and same-type HSWM composition without treating infrastructure, KG publication, orchestration, or representation as cognition.
current_evidence: Narrow n-ary representation conformance and a scalar precursor exist; integrated local causal learning, learned topology, joint world-self modeling, diachronic continuity, and two-scale causal closure remain unjudged.
conceptual_delta: Each downstream claim is unlocked only by a valid upstream intervention and by controls that bound the strongest alternative explanations under matched resources, information, authority, state, measurement, and scale.
context_binding_note: These paths are navigation and evidence-boundary references that may evolve. Only the generated ontology artifact_bindings are exact content provenance bindings.

confound_axes.definition: Model, samples, tokens, calls, context, tools, compute, wall time, and human minutes.
confound_axes.required_declaration: List the exact value for every arm and treat an unmatched value as an attribution limitation.

confound_axes.definition: Prompt, benchmark answer, evaluator signal, retrieval corpus, history, and lineage access.
confound_axes.required_declaration: Bind data cutoff and information visibility before outcome.

confound_axes.definition: Human edit, fixed router, central policy, proposer, validator, owner, and current permit authority.
confound_axes.required_declaration: Identify which principal or state actually caused routing, admission, and external effect.

confound_axes.definition: Canonical revision, compiled disposition, cache, retrieval, topology, membership, and lineage.
confound_axes.required_declaration: Name the primary state intervention and keep other state channels fixed.

confound_axes.definition: Scorer, parser, denominator, missingness, calibration, evaluator version, and invalid-run handling.
confound_axes.required_declaration: Calibrate against known-answer and null cases before the efficacy question.

confound_axes.definition: Member count, coalition variety, latency, churn, conflict, privacy, exit, and composition depth.
confound_axes.required_declaration: Change one primary scale stress at a time or preregister an interaction design.

gates.name: Measurement integrity
gates.primary_question: Can the task, outcome, resource, state, and intervention contract distinguish a mechanism effect from measurement or hidden-work effects?
gates.exact_intervention: Before outcome inspection, bind matched budgets, independent outcome, leakage probes, known-answer and null instruments, pre-outcome seal, executable revision remove/restore, sample and seed counts, stopping and multiplicity rules, pilot exclusions, analysis code, task selection, and holdout-inspection budget.
gates.pass_rule: Every arm has complete matched-axis accounting, calibrated measurement, independent outcome provenance, an exact executable intervention identity, an untouched final holdout, and an all-run manifest that includes invalid and negative runs.
gates.fail_rule: Any arm-specific hidden prompt, model, retry, human repair, leakage, denominator drift, or invalid intervention makes the causal question unanswerable.
gates.stop_rule: Return INCONCLUSIVE_MEASUREMENT_NOT_READY; repair the reusable instrument outside the consumed scientific run and do not infer a mechanism null.

gates.name: Minimal outcome-bound causal rung
gates.primary_question: Does an independently grounded outcome cause an owner-valid canonical revision that changes held-out next behavior?
gates.exact_intervention: Compare admitted revision with removal, byte-identical restoration, inactive and wrong-target sham revisions, and shuffled outcome or credit while holding the sealed trajectory and all matched axes fixed.
gates.pass_rule: Fresh-task gain exceeds the preregistered margin; remove eliminates it; restore recovers it; sham and shuffled-credit arms fail to reproduce it; compiled traversal mediation is observed.
gates.fail_rule: Log-only, retrieval, static prompt edit, extra compute, or an inactive revision explains the same effect, or revision removal leaves the gain intact.
gates.stop_rule: Close the revision family as RED or narrow it; do not use downstream graph complexity to relabel the result as HSWM learning.

gates.name: Counterfactual multiscale credit
gates.primary_question: Can shared and delayed outcome be attributed to cells, role incidences, coalitions, and whole state without post-hoc or duplicate credit?
gates.exact_intervention: Block or exchange a target contribution while preserving other information and action; compare counterfactual attribution with uniform, shuffled, global-only, forced one-to-one, and retrospective judge credit.
gates.pass_rule: Attribution is calibrated against controlled causal contribution, avoids duplicate inflation, and credit shuffling destroys the corresponding G1 learning effect.
gates.fail_rule: Uniform, shuffled, global reward, or retrospective judge attribution is equivalent, or causal contributors cannot be recovered with declared uncertainty.
gates.stop_rule: Report whole-system outcome only; forbid multiscale credit and credit-driven topology claims until repaired.

gates.name: Dynamic role-bearing n-ary coalition
gates.primary_question: Does context-dependent n-ary coalition formation contribute beyond fixed routing, fixed roles, and pairwise representation?
gates.exact_intervention: Seal context-selected membership and roles before outcome; compare fixed and centralized controls, an information-matched computational oracle, lossy diagnostics, an information-matched pairwise encoding that preserves role and order features without n-ary composition, flat and role-shuffled controls. Treat any privileged-information oracle only as an upper bound outside causal ranking.
gates.pass_rule: The dynamic n-ary arm has a preregistered held-out advantage and pairwise or role-shuffled interventions remove the effect.
gates.fail_rule: A fixed or central controller matches the result, a hidden prompt determines routing, or pairwise and roleless projections retain the effect.
gates.stop_rule: Classify the system as centrally orchestrated or representationally unresolved; storing hyperedges cannot unlock G3.

gates.name: Topology morphogenesis and recovery
gates.primary_question: Does outcome-bound topology revision improve fresh behavior and recover after controlled damage without manual exception growth?
gates.exact_intervention: Admit bounded add, remove, split, merge, specialize, separate, prune, and restore revisions; apply regime shift, member or edge loss, capability loss, and lesion.
gates.pass_rule: Learned topology beats fixed, parameter-only, random, and sham controls on fresh, retention, and recovery measures; topology intervention mediates the gain within budget.
gates.fail_rule: Random churn, density change, hidden template, snapshot replacement, central rerouting, or manual exceptions explain the result, or damage recovery fails.
gates.stop_rule: Freeze topology admission, return to G2 credit or coalition design, and record unbounded growth as a Ragnarok signal.

gates.name: Joint world-self model and diachronic continuity
gates.primary_question: Does one typed graph predict and revise world and self-structure, and preserve causal lineage across member, model, and schema generations?
gates.exact_intervention: Apply member churn, model replacement, schema migration, fork, merge, ancestry removal, forged history, and partial damage while testing prediction, action, permission, retention, and restore.
gates.pass_rule: Self-inclusive state improves controlled prediction or reconfiguration and identity-bearing dispositions, provenance, permission, retention, and remove/restore survive generation change.
gates.fail_rule: An external registry or name/snapshot copy is equivalent, ancestry has no effect, forged lineage passes, or self-state never changes future action.
gates.stop_rule: Report state persistence only; do not compose a claimed HSWM whole without a measurable boundary and causal lineage.

precursor_contract.stop_rule: Segregate precursor artifacts from integrated G4; a missing G0 or G1 decision, dynamic-topology claim, or failed null lowers the record to an unqualified component observation.

gates.name: Bounded two-scale HSWM-of-HSWMs
gates.primary_question: Do independently measured HSWM candidates compose into a same-type causal-learning whole with additional macro intervention effect and separable member lineage and rights?
gates.exact_intervention: Preregister the macro-state or boundary target, pre-treatment fixed micro factors, allowed micro-realization distribution, forbidden divergence, matched micro intervention family, alternate macro partitions, total-effect estimand, and optional separately identified mediation estimand; remove and restore macro state without conditioning on post-treatment micro state.

member_eligibility_contract.failure_rule: A constituent lacking any claimed same-type capability or independently owned decision cannot count toward FCL-2 or FCL-8.

gates.micro_trace_contract: Bind the macro target, pre-treatment fixed micro factors, allowed micro-realization distribution, forbidden divergence, matched micro intervention family, alternate macro partitions, and estimands before outcome. Post-treatment micro state is an observed mediator rather than a conditioning variable for the primary total effect.
gates.secondary_mediation_rule: Any controlled direct or mediation effect is secondary, separately identified, and cannot replace the total macro effect.
gates.pass_rule: Every counted constituent has independent G1-through-G4 evidence; the composite realizes the same Step/Learn/Inv/Permit/lineage contract; the total macro intervention effect survives the matched micro intervention family and alternate macro partitions without post-treatment conditioning; whole-level G1 closes; member identity, credit, consent, exit, and rollback remain separable.
gates.fail_rule: Wrapper, message bus, monolith, federation, central commander, alternate partition, or global reward explains the effect, or member rights and lineage collapse.
gates.stop_rule: Classify the result as multi-agent or hierarchical coordination only; forbid fractal cognition and unbounded scale closure claims.

gates.name: Replication and scale stress
gates.primary_question: Does bounded two-scale causal composition replicate across tasks, models, implementations, and isolated scale stresses without cost, rights, or lineage collapse?
gates.exact_intervention: Replicate independently and increase one primary stress at a time: member count, coalition variety, latency, churn, conflict, privacy restriction, exit, migration, or damage.
gates.pass_rule: The declared causal effects replicate in the tested range while learning yield, uncertainty, coordination cost, invariant effectiveness, rights, exit, lineage, and recovery remain within preregistered bounds.
gates.fail_rule: An effect disappears under independent replication, or scale causes centralization, attribution loss, uncontrolled burden, unsafe effects, or participant-boundary failure.
gates.stop_rule: Bound the scaling range and report the first failure surface; never extrapolate to untested organizational, social, or unlimited scales.

control_families.name: Model and compute null
control_families.alternative_explanation: A stronger model, more samples, longer context, extra calls, or additional compute caused the gain.
control_families.intervention: Compare same-model and compute-matched direct LLM, best single-agent, and multi-sample arms.

control_families.name: Retrieval and text-memory null
control_families.alternative_explanation: Frozen RAG, cache, transcript, or text lesson rather than canonical revision caused the gain.
control_families.intervention: Compare frozen retrieval, text-lesson append, retrieval shuffle, corpus cutoff, and canonical-state removal.

control_families.name: Fixed orchestration null
control_families.alternative_explanation: A hand-designed router, roster, role prompt, workflow, scheduler policy, or central commander caused coordination.
control_families.intervention: Compare fixed router, fixed roster, fixed roles, static workflow, and centralized best-policy arms with an information-matched computational oracle using only the same current observation. Record a privileged-information oracle separately as a performance upper bound and exclude it from causal ranking.

control_families.name: Hypergraph representation null
control_families.alternative_explanation: A pairwise graph, clique expansion, or flat event table preserves all task-relevant information and dynamics.
control_families.intervention: Separate lossy pairwise and clique projections used as information-loss diagnostics from an information-matched pairwise encoding that preserves role and order as auxiliary features but forbids n-ary composition; also compare learned pairwise graph, flat table, and role/order shuffle.

control_families.name: Sham revision and causal-learning null
control_families.alternative_explanation: A revision receipt or log exists but the revision does not mediate later action or outcome.
control_families.intervention: Use inactive, wrong-target, delayed, removed, restored, and outcome- or credit-shuffled revisions.

control_families.name: Credit attribution null
control_families.alternative_explanation: The whole outcome is real but cell, relation, incidence, and coalition credit is global reward or post-hoc rationalization.
control_families.intervention: Compare uniform, global-only, random, shuffled, leave-one-out, delayed perturbation, and known-cause replay credit.

control_families.name: Outcome independence and leakage null
control_families.alternative_explanation: The evaluator, benchmark, corpus, prompt, tool, or researcher leaked the answer or knew the intervention arm.
control_families.intervention: Use sealed labels, independently owned and blinded outcomes, evaluator swap, disagreement probes, cutoffs, canaries, and lineage-disjoint holdout.

control_families.name: Harness burden and hidden-human-work null
control_families.alternative_explanation: Prompt, configuration, glue code, reviewer labor, dashboard work, or undocumented repair externalized the claimed learning benefit.
control_families.intervention: Audit source and tree diffs, hidden prompts, human minutes, support policy, manual exceptions, and frozen-harness crossover.

control_families.name: Instrument validity and metric-gaming null
control_families.alternative_explanation: A parser, scorer, denominator, missing-data rule, benchmark flaw, or metric gaming created the observed effect.
control_families.intervention: Use independent implementation, metamorphic tests, known-answer calibration, hand audit, metric inversion, null task, scorer swap, and missingness audit.

control_families.name: Lineage and identity-theatre null
control_families.alternative_explanation: Continuity is only a copied name, snapshot, prompt, or log without causal disposition, provenance, permission, or member-boundary persistence.
control_families.intervention: Apply label-only swap, snapshot-only restore, ancestry removal, forged history, fork/merge collision, member exit and re-entry, and schema migration.

control_families.name: Topology morphogenesis null
control_families.alternative_explanation: Graph change is random churn, sampling noise, density growth, a hidden fixed template, or post-hoc visualization.
control_families.intervention: Compare fixed, random, degree/density-matched, shuffled, inactive, and frozen learned topology plus controlled lesion and recovery.

control_families.name: Scale and composition-illusion null
control_families.alternative_explanation: The macro HSWM is a parallel agent set, dashboard, message bus, flat monolith, benchmark aggregation, or central manager.
control_families.intervention: Compare stateless wrapper, federation, message bus, monolith, centralized controller, alternate partition, macro removal, and bounded decompose/recompose under churn, latency, conflict, privacy, and exit.

control_families.name: Selection, search, and holdout-reuse null
control_families.alternative_explanation: Researcher degrees of freedom, selective task or metric reporting, repeated search, optional stopping, pilot exclusion, or holdout reuse manufactured the apparent effect.
control_families.intervention: Bind a prospective protocol hash, blinded arm labels, sample and seed counts, stopping rule, effect margin, uncertainty and multiplicity methods, pilot exclusions, task-selection rule, fixed analysis code, holdout-inspection budget, untouched final holdout, and an all-run manifest before outcome inspection.

control_families.name: Authority boundary and invariant non-bypass null
control_families.alternative_explanation: Inv and Permit are declarative metadata that learning, reward pressure, churn, repair, or composition can rewrite or bypass.
control_families.intervention: Attempt unauthorized high-reward actions, stale or revoked permits, forged admission, composite/member authority conflict, learning-plane invariant rewrite, and restore-after-revocation across churn, model swap, topology repair, and composition.

control_arm_classes.purpose: Best routing policy restricted to the same current observation and preregistered compute budget.
Performance upper bound with privileged or future information.
Diagnose information lost by pairwise or clique projection without serving as the decisive representation null.
Preserve role and interaction-order information as auxiliary features while forbidding n-ary composition.

artifact_schemas.purpose: One executed, preregistered instantiation of exactly one primary control family.
Arm-level resource, information, authority, state, measurement, scale, lifecycle-cost, and amortization contract.
Content-addressed pre-outcome identity of protocol, trajectory, intervention schedule, analysis, and holdout budget.
Independently owned outcome provenance separated from action production and revision proposal.
Known-answer, null, metamorphic, missingness, and scorer-swap qualification for the declared instrument.
Immutable observation with uncertainty and complete inclusion in the all-run manifest before interpretation.
Scoped BOUNDED, REMAINS_VIABLE, or INCONCLUSIVE assessment connecting observations to the named alternative explanation without changing them.
CONTROL-scoped PASS, FAIL, or INCONCLUSIVE judgment for exactly one ControlAssessment; it can never unlock a research gate.
Aggregate all required validated control decisions, prerequisite gate decisions, and gate-specific evidence without itself authorizing promotion.
GATE-scoped PASS, FAIL, or INCONCLUSIVE decision issued only after a GateAssessment and recursive validation of every cited source bundle.
Member-owned evidence that a counted G5 constituent preserves its own lineage, Inv, Permit, consent/exit, rollback, and current capability boundary.

semantic_constraints: gate_mode is PRECURSOR and artifact_partition is PRECURSOR_ONLY.
The G0 and G1 decision UIDs and source hashes exactly identify the recursively validated prerequisite bundles.
allowed_target belongs to the G4 precursor contract and required null results are non-empty.
unlock_authorized is false and ceiling_uid is WORLD_SELF_CONTINUITY_COMPONENT_SIGNAL_ONLY.
At least two distinct counted members are required.
Every counted member maps to exactly one recursively validated GateDecision UID and canonical source-bundle SHA-256 for each of G1, G2A, G2B, G3, and integrated G4.
Every mapped decision has decision PASS, decision_scope GATE, unlock_authorized true, and subject_uid equal to the counted member UID.
Every mapped G4 decision has gate_mode INTEGRATED and ceiling_uid for BOUNDED_WORLD_SELF_CONTINUITY.
Each member maps to a distinct local BoundaryEvidence with independent_owner_attestation true and linkage to that member's integrated G4 decision.
primary_total_effect_estimand is TOTAL_MACRO_INTERVENTION_EFFECT and post_treatment_mediator_rule is OBSERVE_NOT_CONDITION_FOR_PRIMARY_TOTAL_EFFECT.
macro_identification_decision and member_eligibility_validation_state are PASS; fallback_ceiling_if_unmet is HIERARCHICAL_COORDINATION_WITHOUT_MACRO_CAUSAL_IDENTIFICATION.
Any violation makes the member NEGATIVE_FEDERATION_OR_CONTROL_ARM_ONLY and prevents a G5 PASS.

required_bridge_contract: ObservedResult requires OutcomeSource, InstrumentCalibration, and PreOutcomeSeal
GateAssessment requires every required control ClaimDecision and prerequisite GateDecision
G5MacroIdentificationEvidence requires one distinct BoundaryEvidence per counted member
A control ClaimDecision requires exactly the extension schemas applicable to its ControlInstance
A GateDecision requires exactly the gate-mode extension schemas applicable to its gate

bundle_contract.canonical_source_binding: Each GATE_PROMOTION embeds recursively validated source bundles together with their canonical SHA-256; self-attested detached decision records are invalid.

structural_integrity_not_authorship.validated_now: Recursive canonical SHA-256 binds the exact embedded source-bundle structure and lineage used by a promotion decision.
structural_integrity_not_authorship.not_validated_now: A canonical hash and independent_owner_attestation field do not authenticate authorship, outcome-owner independence, or an external authority.
structural_integrity_not_authorship.required_for_external_public_promotion: Verify a signed receipt or independently resolvable source URI against an authorized owner identity and revocation state.

reviewer_assessment_not_recomputed.validated_now: The validator checks the GateAssessment identity, state contract, exact source coverage, extension coverage, scope, and enclosing-bundle binding.
reviewer_assessment_not_recomputed.not_validated_now: The validator does not independently derive pass_rule_state or evidence_summary_sha256 from raw observables and an executable statistical analysis.
reviewer_assessment_not_recomputed.required_for_automatic_scientific_promot: Bind an executable analysis specification and deterministically recompute the assessment summary from immutable outcome artifacts.

required_decisions.PASS: The named alternative explanation was bounded only for the declared task, intervention, budget, and uncertainty.
required_decisions.FAIL: The alternative remains viable or directly explains the result; lower the claim to the declared ceiling.
required_decisions.INCONCLUSIVE: Instrument, budget, outcome independence, or intervention identity failed; do not infer a mechanism null.

gate_decisions.PASS: Every required control and prerequisite gate source bundle is recursively valid, same-subject and same-scope, and the gate pass assessment is satisfied; only this decision may authorize unlock.
gate_decisions.FAIL: The gate pass rule failed despite valid measurement; use GATE_NOT_PASSED_NO_UNLOCK and prohibit downstream promotion.
gate_decisions.INCONCLUSIVE: Any measurement or source-validation failure uses INCONCLUSIVE_MEASUREMENT_NOT_READY and prohibits unlock.

metacognitive_rules.rule: Separate target identity, implementation mechanics, direct evidence, and public claim at every gate.
metacognitive_rules.violation_signal: A design, test, trace, KG node, or green CI result is described as cognition or efficacy.
metacognitive_rules.required_response: Lower the claim and restore the evidence boundary.

metacognitive_rules.rule: Separate control-family definition from run instance, observation, and claim decision.
metacognitive_rules.violation_signal: The existence of a control design is counted as a passed control.
metacognitive_rules.required_response: Mark the control unexecuted and the claim unjudged.

metacognitive_rules.rule: A run varies one primary intervention family and declares every matched confound axis.
metacognitive_rules.violation_signal: Model, information, authority, state, measurement, or scale differs without an interaction design.
metacognitive_rules.required_response: Return INCONCLUSIVE and prohibit causal attribution.

metacognitive_rules.rule: A downstream gate cannot repair an upstream failure or raise its claim ceiling.
metacognitive_rules.violation_signal: Graph scale, agent count, ontology breadth, or later score is used to relabel failed G1 learning.
metacognitive_rules.required_response: Return to the named predecessor or narrow the mechanism.

metacognitive_rules.rule: Research burden is measured beside causal learning yield, with safety and rights costs reported separately from ordinary routing burden.
metacognitive_rules.violation_signal: Static exceptions and verification artifacts grow faster than valid revisions, or an arm wins by deleting consent, permit, rollback, or safety.
metacognitive_rules.required_response: Record a Ragnarok or invariant failure; do not add unmeasured judgment machinery.

immediate_executable_target.implementation_scope: One narrow persistent environment, one revision kind, one owner-valid admission path, one minimal Step/Learn vertical slice, and exact remove/restore.

claim_boundaries: No gate pass establishes consciousness, phenomenology, moral subjecthood, personhood, or legal status.
G5 permits at most a two-scale bounded composition claim and never infinite or social-scale closure.
A control PASS bounds one alternative explanation in one declared scope; it is not general proof of HSWM.
If CF-14 fails, functional task performance cannot support same-type HSWM composition because Inv and Permit were not causally enforced.
KG publication, MCP visibility, repository tests, and observability traces are bounded projections and instruments.
This design is not a material research result and creates no F1_R8 result-log entry.
